title: The coverage report and its gate: every agent's and every kind of help's training data, counted
request: The owner's goal: every agent collects its thinking and reasoning, for every kind of help; 36.1 turns the gaps into numbers.
spec: Phase 12 plan 36.1: counts per model type by agent and by kind of help (runs, kept exchanges, recorded thinking, reasoning by source, outcomes, Persian and English) into the catalog; a gate test that every agent and track has a capture path.
plan: Write the gate and report tests.

decisions.decision: A request is counted once by its workspace and its body without the store's context
decisions.why: the store keeps a rewritten log again whole, so the same line returns under new record ids

decisions.decision: Only the person's own label moves a draft to another kind of help
decisions.why: a model's or a blind label is evidence about the reading, not the person's choice

decisions.decision: Only the curation choices of the kept exchanges are read
decisions.why: all choices took 2.6 GB on an 8 GB machine; the report needs about two thousand

change: dclab_rnd/store/coverage.py (new), store/catalog.py (keeps the coverage summary; the repository copy holds no time), Makefile (coverage), tests/test_store_coverage.py.

findings.defect: Model calls were counted two or three times
findings.scenario: 23,515 calls reported where about 11,866 distinct requests exist
findings.cause: dedup by store record id, which changes when a rewritten log is kept again
findings.fix: dedup by workspace and the request's body without the store's context; database rows counted too

findings.defect: The orchestrator's runs fell under its purpose and the report showed a false gap
findings.scenario: 16 runs under home_orchestrator, and 'home.project: no run recorded'
findings.cause: runs recorded by the purpose name
findings.fix: a run's name read through the harness's purposes when it is not an agent

findings.defect: The report peaked at 2.3 GB of memory
findings.scenario: every curation choice loaded on the 8 GB machine
findings.fix: only the kept exchanges' choices, read line by line: 0.9 GB

findings.defect: Runs tied to no draft were counted as prediction, and any label moved a draft
findings.scenario: intern sessions under prediction; a blind label moved a draft to analysis
findings.cause: an unknown id defaulted to prediction; every first label replaced the value used
findings.fix: only drafts known to be built are prediction; only the person's own label replaces the value used

findings.defect: Calls by kind of help were always zero, Home's own conversations were not Home's, and the catalog copy changed on every run
findings.scenario: a column of zeros; 931 examples under another name; a committed file rewritten by the time
findings.cause: calls never added to the track table; an unmapped task name; one writer kept the summary's time
findings.fix: calls by track; home_conversation mapped to home; the time stripped from the copy

measurements.name: the coverage report on the real store and workspace
measurements.gate: the report runs read-only, under about one gigabyte of memory, and counts each request once
measurements.result: 29 seconds, 0.9 GB peak; 12,103 calls; 36 gaps by name; every kind of help but prediction has no run yet
measurements.against_gate: 0.9 GB under about one gigabyte; each request once
limits: the counts describe this machine's store and workspace on one night

outcome: The coverage report and its gate are built and reviewed: every agent and kind of help has a capture path or fails the suite, and the report counts each request once, in under a gigabyte. It shows the gap the owner's goal names: no run yet under analysis, preparation, reporting, business or advice.
lessons: Count by what a record is, not by the id the store gave a copy of it.
On a small machine, load only the rows a report needs.
risks: The report reads the whole store: its time grows with it.
